description: This source file defines the CommandResolver enum that provides various static methods to resolve commands, manage project paths, handle SSH connections, and interface with Node.js environments in the openclaw project. It includes functions for locating executables, constructing command lines, parsing SSH targets, and managing remote settings.

classes.name: CommandResolver
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods for command resolution, environment setup, SSH handling, and path management within the openclaw project.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Determines the entry point file for the project, checking existence of common JavaScript files.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves the runtime environment, optionally accepting specific search paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command line to invoke a runtime with given parameters.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command to display a runtime resolution failure message.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell command to output an error message and exit.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the project root directory, with fallback options.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores the project root path in user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the project root directory.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Generates a list of preferred executable search paths.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable with a given name in provided or preferred paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the openclaw CLI executable in search paths.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the project-specific openclaw executable, primarily during development.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Finds the path to the Node.js CLI script for openclaw.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks if any openclaw invocation method is available in the environment.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command line to invoke openclaw via Node.js, SSH, or local executable.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Alias for openclawNodeCommand to provide a simplified interface.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves remote connection settings, possibly from defaults or configuration files.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks if the current connection mode is remote.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses an SSH target string into its components: user, host, port.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides validation messages for SSH target strings.

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Creates a structured SSH target object from components if valid.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Constructs SSH command line arguments based on target and options.

methods.name: sshNodeCommand
methods.description: Builds an SSH command that runs the openclaw CLI on a remote host.
